title: possession (share of time on the ball) on ordinary play: the ball rule, a learned estimator from the teams' shapes, a constant
written: 2026-11-17, before any possession figure on these windows is computed
owner request: 2026-11-17: after shots (stopped), possession, pass accuracy %, distance per player; possession = share of time on the ball, bar within 5 points
units: the 47 ordinary-play windows of 3 min (shots_learn/negatives: 40 new + 7 dev; 138 min, 10 matches), our pipeline's outputs as relinked there (metric_v3s_link: players with kit teams, our ball, pitch metres)
truth (per frame, live time only): BAS actions sorted by frame; between two consecutive actions: dead (excluded) if the first is OUT or the gap exceeds 6 s; else the first action's side if both are the same side, else the first half of the gap to the first's side and the second half to the second's; frames before the first or after the last action excluded. Share = left frames / live frames
our teams -> sides: per window, our team_A / team_B mapped to left / right by majority over detections matched to the truth's people (Hungarian on pitch metres within 2 m, every 25th frame); evaluation only

estimators.R (ball rule, as events_stats retuned): per frame with our ball, the team of the nearest team-labelled player within 4 m; held up to 2 s; share over the frames with a team (0.5 if none)
estimators.L (learned): per second, HistGradientBoosting (default settings, seed 0) predicting P(team_A on the ball) from team_A-minus-team_B and per-team features: labelled players, centroid x / y, spread x / y, convex-hull area (one frame per second), distance between the centroids, and R's frame fractions for A / B / none and ball-to-nearest distances; trained on the live seconds of the other matches' windows (truth side via the mapping), leave one match out; share = mean P(A) over all the window's seconds

primary: per window (47), absolute error of the left share, L - C, mean over windows, 95% bootstrap over matches (5,000 draws, seed 0)
adopt L if: L - C <= -0.03 with the interval below 0
also reported: per match (its windows pooled, ~14 min): absolute error in points for C, R, L, and how many matches are within 5 points (the owner's bar)
per-second accuracy of L's side on live seconds
the truth's spread of shares (per window, per match): a constant can only be wrong by that much
what this cannot show: whole matches (14 min per match here), the owner's camera
